questions.question: In females, the uterus is ________.
questions.solution: Uterus is a reproductive organ found in female human body which is responsible for developing and sustaining the fetus. It is also known as the womb.

questions.question: Sher Shah Suri defeated which Mughal emperor?
questions.solution: Sher Shah Suri defeated Mughal emperor Humayun in the battle of Chausa which was fought on June 26, 1539. The battle was fought in Buxar which is currently located in Bihar. As he was victorious so he crowned himself Farīd al-Dīn Shēr Shah.

questions.question: Who has won the most number of Gold Medals in Olympics?
questions.solution: Michael Phelps has won 28 medals in Olympics so far out of which 23 are gold, 3 are silver and 2 are bronze. Larisa Latynina is the second highest in terms of medal tally. She has won 15 Olympic medals.

questions.question: After the defeat at Plassey, Sirajuddaullah was assassinated and ________ was made the nawab.
questions.solution: Battle of Plassey was fought on June 23, 1757 where British defeated the Nawab of Bengal, Sirajuddaullah. Mir Jafar, the commander in chief of the Nawab's army was bribed by the British and he conspired against his own king which resulted in Nawab’s defeat. He was later made the new Nawab of Bengal by Robert Clive.

questions.question: Fabric made from ________ does not get wrinkled easily.
questions.solution: Polyester fabric does not wrinkle easily and is also light-weight because of which it is heavily used in making clothes.

questions.question: ________ scheme launched by the Central Government aims to cover all those children by 2020 who are either unvaccinated, or are partially vaccinated against seven vaccine preventable diseases.

options.text: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana

questions.solution: Mission Indradhanush was launched by Government of India in 2014 and it aims to cover all those children by 2020 who are either unvaccinated, or are partially vaccinated against seven vaccine preventable diseases. These diseases are diphtheria, whooping cough, tetanus, polio, tuberculosis, measles and hepatitis B.

questions.question: Shyam Saran Negi, India’s oldest voter hails from which state?
questions.solution: Shyam Saran Negi was born on July 1, 1917 in Himachal Pradesh. He is not just the oldest but in fact the first voter as he casted he first vote in the General elections of 1951. He has casted his vote in every single election ever since.

questions.question: ________ approves constitutional amendments.
questions.solution: The procedure to amend the constitution is listed in Part XX of the Constitution i.e. Article 368. Any constitutional amendment has to be approved by both Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha by absolute and special majority (depending upon the kind of amendment). Once passed by both houses, the bill is then sent to the President for approval.

questions.question: The ________ balance is equal to capital flows from the rest of the world, minus capital flows to the rest of the world.
questions.solution:
Capital account is a part of the balance of payments. It shows the net capital inflow from the rest of the world in a given period. Mathematically, Capital account is expressed as:

Capital account = FDI + Portfolio Investment + Reserve Surplus + Other Investments

questions.question: As the river approaches the sea, the speed of the flowing water decreases and the river begins to break up into a number of streams called ________.
questions.solution: A distributary is a stream that breaks down from a running river and does not join it back. This usually happens, when a river is about to reach a sea or an ocean and is losing its speed as a result of the same. Hoogli river is a distributary of Ganges river.

questions.question: "Taxes on agricultural income" is listed in the ________ list given in the Seventh Schedule in the Constitution of India.
questions.solution:
Seventh Schedule of the Indian Constitution provides for various items divided between Union, State and Concurrent list.

**Union List: **100 items on which Parliament has exclusive power to make laws

**State List: **61 items on which States can make and regulate laws

**Concurrent List: **52 items on which both Central and State governments can make laws

questions.question: The method of soil conservation in which rocks are piled up to slow down the flow of water which prevents gullies and further soil loss is called?
questions.solution: Rock dams are small barriers made up of stone, sand or gravel across a drainage. Its main purpose is to reduce erosion in a drainage channel by restricting the velocity of flow in the channel.

questions.question: If the force applied on the object is in the direction of its motion, the speed of the object ________.
questions.solution: According to Newton’s second law of motion, if force is applied to an object in the same direction in which the object is moving, it produces an acceleration in the body, increasing its speed.

questions.question: If a consumer's demand for a good moves in the same direction as the consumer's income, the consumer's demand for that good must be inversely related to the price of the good is called ________.
questions.solution:
Law of Demand

 
 
 
Demand decreases as price increases and vice-versa

 
 
 

 
 
Law of Supply

 
 
 
Supply increases as price increases and vice-versa

 
 
 

 
 
Law of Substitution

 
 
 
Consumer will go on substituting one commodity with higher marginal utility for another commodity with lower marginal utility till the marginal utility of each commodity is equal.

questions.question: The salt concentration is greater than ________ % in hypersaline lagoons.
questions.solution: A Hyper Saline Lake or Lagoon is a water body which contains high concentration of salts usually even more than ocean water. Ocean water has a salinity of 3.5%. Dead Sea is an example of hypersaline lagoon as it has a salinity of 34.2%.

questions.question: The shape of the outer part of the ear is like a ________.
questions.solution: Outer ear is the external part of the ear. It consists of auricle and ear canal and is shaped like a funnel. This shape helps in collecting sound and sending it further to ear drums.
